title: Ali's Eastern Delight
description: A sweet and flaky puff pastry filled with a delicious eastern-inspired filling, perfect for a dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: ali's spice mix
ingredients.notes: available in most middle eastern markets

instructions: Roll out puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out a rectangle of pastry, about 1/2 inch larger on all sides than the filling.
In a small bowl, mix together ali's spice mix, grated ginger, honey, walnuts, and sugar.
Spread the spice mix evenly over the center of the pastry rectangle, leaving a 1/2 inch border on all sides.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water, then fold the pastry over the filling to form a triangle.
Press the edges together to seal the pastry, then use a knife or pastry brush to create a decorative edge.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and brush with a little bit of egg wash.
Bake the pastry for 20-25 minutes, or until it is golden brown and puffed.
Remove the pastry from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
